Name: Town Fields
Author: Peekabo0
Description:
[color=#0c343d][size=4]Events and map final touches out now!! (〝⌒∇⌒〝)[/size][/color]

This mod edits vanilla maps into a more rural and natural style with more wooded, vibrant, and above all, more decorated exteriors!

[color=#ffff00][size=4]Mod Contents:[/size][/color]

The mod includes maps for the forest, backwoods, bus stop, town, mountain, and spa area.

[color=#ff0000][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/color]

For the mod to work, you simply need:

[list=1]
[*]Content Patched.[/*]
[*]Misc Map Actions Properties.[/*]
[*]DaisyNiko TileSheets.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Installation:[/size][/color]

[list]
[*]Download the Town Fields mod.[/*]
[*]Extract it from its zip folder.[/*]
[*]Copy and paste it into your mods folder.[/*]
[*]Open SMAPI and enjoy![/*]
[/list]
[color=#f9cb9c][size=4]Recommendations:[/size][/color]

If you decide to install the mod and use it in an existing game, I recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41178]JP Cheats Menu[/url] mod, specifically the "World/Clear Location" option, to remove any previously generated bushes, trees, or grass from the maps.

[color=#93c47d][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/color]

[size=4]Compatible with PC and Cinderbox. [/size][color=#ffff00][size=4]And [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49272?tab=files&file_id=176102]Android now[/url] ヽ(o´3`o)ﾉ[/size][/color]

[color=#93c47d][size=4]Recolor Compatibility:[/size][/color]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko]DaisyNiko[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39407]Kookiefroggie's Recolor[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DustBeauty?gameId=1303]Dustbeauty's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26027]Foliage and Recolor[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial version[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095]Soft Slow Seasons[/url][/*]
[/list]
[color=#f6b26b][size=4]Partially compatible with Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff0000][size=5]Not tested with/on expansions.[/size][/color]
